name: The Jacket Garden

fieldPatches.label: Sugar 0.8, nutrient 0.2 and silicate 0.3 per cell

founders.label: Dartfins: 6 with a mineral jacket, present at creation

question: Is delayed capture worth the cost?
expectedObservationsText: A hundred Sprinters, twelve Dartfins and two Needlejaws scattered on a sugar patch with silicate. Six Dartfins start with Mineral jacket and six without; those abilities were given by the recipe and are present at creation: they did not evolve here. Every jacket starts empty. A jacketed Dartfin spends energy and silicate building its jacket and moves more slowly; a Needlejaw needs longer contact to take a jacketed Dartfin.
